feature: Issue 182 — withdraw a queued guidance message

userStories.title: Registry withdraw primitive and typed DELETE route
userStories.description: As an Archon operator, I want a synchronous closed-safe withdraw primitive and a bodyless typed DELETE route, so that a queued guidance message can be removed from a live or parked node queue idempotently and without mutation on any refusal path.
acceptanceCriteria: NodeSteeringHandle.withdraw(messageId) exists after drain() in packages/workflows/src/steering-registry.ts: synchronous, removes only the matching pending item via splice, returns false when phase==='closed' or id not found, never touches accepted memory, never closes an emptied handle, never resumes parked, never logs content

All 8 new registry tests pass: order preservation (remove B from A/B/C leaves A/C, phase stays live, only pendingCount decrements), never-seen and already-drained ids return false mutation-free, repeat withdraw returns false, replayed enqueue(A) after withdraw returns original duplicate receipt without requeueing, parked handle removal succeeds while parked and later resume drains only siblings, closed handle keeps full snapshot unchanged, removing last item does not auto-close (only closeIfEmpty seals), later drain() cannot return a withdrawn item

withdrawWorkflowNodeParamsSchema and withdrawWorkflowNodeResponseSchema added to packages/server/src/routes/schemas/workflow.schemas.ts (runId/nodeId min(1), messageId uuid, .strict(), .openapi('WithdrawWorkflowNodeResponse'), type derived via z.infer); steeringValidationErrorHook doc comment broadened to all steering routes with no behavior change
steering-api-contract.md gains one sentence clarifying DELETE may remove an accepted item from a parked retained queue while sends remain refused and closed handles still return node_finished

DELETE-only auth middleware registered at the colon-param path BEFORE the OpenAPI route in packages/server/src/routes/api.ts (gated identity check only, nested 401, no body parsing, POST middleware not widened); route registered via registerOpenApiRoute(withdrawWorkflowNodeRoute, handler, steeringValidationErrorHook) with declared 400/401/403/404/409/422/500 steeringJsonError responses

Handler order implemented exactly: auth → validated params → run load (null=404) → events+projection+registry handle → precedence ladder (no projection+no handle=404; terminal run=409; projected completed/failed/skipped=409; closed handle=409; no handle=422; parked allowed) → run re-read (null=404, terminal=409) → post-await handle.snapshot().phase recheck (closed=409) → synchronous withdraw with no intervening await → success log api.workflow_node_withdraw_completed with only {runId,nodeId,messageId,operatorUserId,removed} → exact 200 {success:true,message_id}; exceptions log api.workflow_node_withdraw_failed and return nested 500 internal_error

New route test block 'DELETE /api/workflows/runs/:runId/nodes/:nodeId/queue/:messageId — withdraw queued guidance' in api.workflow-runs.test.ts with deleteNodeQueue helper covers all 19 cases: actor matrix 200s, gated no-identity+non-UUID returns 401 before 400, authenticated non-UUID returns 400 invalid_request, unknown run/node 404, terminal run 409, projected completed/failed/skipped 409, closed handle 409, no-handle running node 422, handle-without-projection 200, parked AskHuman 200 removing only that item, run disappearing on final re-read 404, run cancelled on final re-read 409, handle closing during final await 409 with item still queued, injected event-store exception nested 500, exact 200 response shape (only success+message_id), repeat/drained/never-seen 200 idempotency; refusal cases assert no queue/transcript/run-writer mutation via before-request snapshot

packages/web/src/lib/api.generated.d.ts regenerated from a server owned by this worktree on a verified port (lsof-checked, /api/openapi.json confirmed to contain the DELETE path and WithdrawWorkflowNodeResponse before and after generation; alternate PORT + openapi-typescript CLI used if 3090 belongs to another session); generated diff contains only the additive path/schema; only the recorded server PID is stopped

Validation passes: (cd packages/workflows && bun test src/steering-registry.test.ts), (cd packages/server && bun test src/routes/api.workflow-runs.test.ts -t 'withdraw queued guidance'), (cd packages/server && bun test src/routes/api.workflow-runs.test.ts -t 'queued guidance') proving no Story 2.1 regression, bun run type-check, bun run lint
No changes to dag-executor.ts, send route behavior, database code, validation hook behavior, or package exports
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow phase-01-start.md exactly — it contains the withdraw() implementation snippet, the 10-step handler ordering contract, and the generated-type procedure. Mirror the send route's target ladder inline; do NOT extract a shared abstraction. The post-await phase recheck (step 7) is mandatory: it closes the terminal-handle race the original draft missed. Import z from @hono/zod-openapi. Never run bare 'bun test' at repo root. Steering keeps the ratified broad actor grant; log never includes message content.

userStories.title: Delete control in Legacy and Console docks
userStories.description: As an Archon operator, I want an accessible message-specific delete button on each queued guidance row in both node-room shells, so that I can withdraw a pending item with predictable state, focus, and geometry behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: SteeringDockState in packages/web/src/lib/steering-dock.ts gains readonly withdrawingMessageId: string|null (initial null); every existing constructor/transition preserves it, including deliberate change to resolveGuidanceSuccess so a send success appends without losing an active withdraw id

New exports added and pure-tested: beginWithdraw (sets id only when message exists in sent and no withdraw active, else same-state no-op; never alters sent/inFlight/pendingRetry/refusal), resolveWithdrawSuccess (removes exactly that receipt, preserves sibling order and send state, clears id+refusal; stale/mismatched id is no-op), resolveWithdrawFailure (retains rows/send state, stores refusal, clears matching id; mismatched is no-op), STEERING_DELETE_LABEL='delete', deleteButtonAccessibleName → 'delete · <trimmed message>', RemovalFocusTarget type, nextFocusAfterRemoval (next → previous → field; unknown → field)

withdrawNodeGuidance(runId,nodeId,messageId) added in both packages/web/src/lib/api.ts and packages/web/src/experiments/console/skills/runs.ts: DELETE with encodeURIComponent path params, no body and no synthetic JSON content type, no automatic retry, failures normalized through existing toSteeringSendError; generated WithdrawWorkflowNodeResponse type re-exported from each request layer

Both ComposerDock.tsx and ConsoleComposerDock.tsx: optional withdraw prop defaulting to shell helper, exported WithdrawNodeGuidance type, Map<string,HTMLButtonElement> ref cleaned on null callbacks, pendingFocusRef, tabIndex={-1} ref on detached role=alert disclosure

Each queued row renders a native button[type=button] after the sent text with aria-label from deleteButtonAccessibleName(receipt.message), visible text 'delete', aria-disabled when any withdraw is active (never native disabled), min-h-[24px] min-w-[24px] plus horizontal padding, flex-none at the row's right edge, message span remaining min-w-0 flex-1 overflow-hidden text-ellipsis whitespace-nowrap; Legacy ring focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-accent-bright focus-visible:-outline-offset-2, Console ring with outline-accent-bright! and outline-offset-2; no new animation

Click handler order: return when withdraw active → capture ordered ids + compute focus target → beginWithdraw → call injected helper with (runId, namespaced nodeId, row id) → on 200 apply resolveWithdrawSuccess → on failure clear pending focus and apply resolveWithdrawFailure(...,toSteeringRefusal(error)); effect keyed to dock.sent focuses mapped delete button else textarea then clears ref

Delete available in composer and blocked modes when rows exist (pending Ask blocks send only); hidden branch and detached copy unchanged except alert gains programmatic focus; 422 transitions focus the detached alert, applied equally to send-triggered 422

Component tests in both shells pass with deferred nextWithdraw injection: two rows expose visible delete + message-specific aria-label + native type + 24px/focus classes; first-row click calls withdraw exactly once with ('run-1','grp.body',firstId); pending state guards every handler and second click issues no request while Queue/send stays usable; success removes only selected row, updates 'queued · n'/list label/status text, moves focus to next row; last-row delete focuses previous, only-row delete hides band and focuses textarea; 409 keeps row+focus on its button, clears aria-disabled, shows existing role=alert, never leaves focus on document.body; 422 focuses detached alert (same assertion added to existing send-422 case); blocked-by-ask rerender still invokes withdraw and removes parked item; empty/generating/hidden have no control
Console isolation suite green — no Console production file imports @/lib/api or Legacy components; NodeTranscriptPane/ConsoleNodeRoom tests pass unchanged

Validation passes: (cd packages/web && bun test src/lib/steering-dock.test.ts), (cd packages/web && NODE_ENV=development bun test src/components/workflows/ComposerDock.test.tsx src/components/workflows/NodeTranscriptPane.test.tsx), (cd packages/web && NODE_ENV=development bun test src/experiments/console/components/ConsoleComposerDock.test.tsx src/experiments/console/components/ConsoleNodeRoom.test.tsx src/experiments/console/console-isolation.test.ts), bun run type-check, bun run lint
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow phase-02-web-delete-control-in-both-shells.md exactly — it contains the full state-function signatures, transition invariants, class requirements per shell, and all 10 component-test scenarios. Keep renderers thin; state/focus wording lives in @/lib/steering-dock. Single active withdraw id is deliberate (one refusal channel, one focus transfer). Uses the WithdrawWorkflowNodeResponse generated type from US-001 — if it is missing, US-001 is not done. Do NOT rename toSteeringSendError, refactor the mockup's older inset structure, or add axe. The current full-bleed queue band is the baseline.

userStories.title: E2E evidence, acceptance report, and closeout
userStories.description: As an Archon maintainer, I want real-server Playwright proof on both shells that withdraw prevents provider delivery, honest visual/accessibility evidence, a criterion-mapped acceptance report, and the sprint-status closeout committed into the develop PR, so that Issue #182 can be merged and closed.
acceptanceCriteria: New spec e2e/ui/agent-withdraw-guidance.spec.ts exists, self-contained with local helpers (openGuidanceRoom, field/list locators, route path, node-start poll, transcript projection) — agent-queue-guidance.spec.ts is NOT refactored; uses [P1] and stable [V:withdraw.*] ids, tracked runtime fixtures, and event/response/DOM/status waits with no fixed sleeps

[V:withdraw.drain-console] and [V:withdraw.drain-legacy] pass: two queued rows (first long/obsolete, second with echoPrompt:true), queued·2 asserted, message-specific accessible names + native button types + no horizontal overflow verified, long first message elides at Legacy 460px and Console 1440×900 plus 460px overflow guard, delete target measures ≥24×24 with nonzero computed focus outline, keyboard activation used (Enter on one surface, Space on the other), DELETE response awaited — no request body, exact path id, exact 200 {success:true,message_id:firstId} — then queued·1, only second row remains, focus on its delete control, and after completion node messages contain exactly one resumed echo of the second prompt and neither the first text nor an echo including it; node keeps one execution and one node_started event

[V:withdraw.last-console] and [V:withdraw.last-legacy] pass: single echoPrompt-marked message, keyboard-activated delete returns exact DELETE 200, band/list disappears, focus lands on labelled textarea with document.activeElement !== body, reduced-motion emulation confirms identical final DOM/focus state, and no resumed echo contains the unique marker after completion

[V:withdraw.route-ladder] passes via archon.starterFetch: live-node DELETE → exact 200, repeat → identical 200, never-queued UUID → 200 echoing id, 'not-a-uuid' → nested 400 invalid_request, unknown node → nested 404, unknown run → nested 404, tracked detached run (started via startDetachedWorkflow) → nested 422 not_steerable_here, completed run → nested 409 node_finished, and node-message counts are compared before/after refusal requests without claiming E2E can inspect the process-local queue

Evidence captured under plans/260919-0135-issue-182-withdraw-queued-guidance-message/reports/evidence/: per-surface two-row and one-row screenshots, accessible names, DOM button types, measured target width/height, overflow/wrapping facts, active element before/after removal, visible outline width/color, viewport and room width, reduced-motion parity

Full validation sequence green in order: (cd e2e && npm run typecheck); bun run --cwd e2e test:ui -- --grep 'withdraw' ; bun run --cwd e2e test:ui -- --grep 'withdraw|queue guidance' (Story 2.1 regression); bun run validate; bun run format:check and git diff --check on the final report/status diff (re-running validate if non-markdown/YAML files were touched)

reports/acceptance.md written only from observed results mapping each Story 2.2 criterion to test names, exact commands/result counts, evidence filenames and measured values, delivery-exclusion assertion, race/refusal assertions, known v1 limitations (drain-race ambiguity, local-only UI, process-local queue), and explicitly unrun checks (axe/live screen reader if not run); no pre-created passing claims

_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/agent-node-room/sprint-status.yaml changes ONLY 2-2-withdraw-a-queued-guidance-message to done, after all gates pass, committed BEFORE the PR is opened; 2-1 untouched

PR created via gh pr create --base develop with body built from .github/pull_request_template.md (Problem and outcome, Review guidance, Solution, Validation kept; instructional comments and non-material conditional sections deleted), containing 'Closes #182' and calling out the final phase-check race and delivery-exclusion test for reviewers; focused conventional commits without issue/phase/audit labels or AI references
git status --short inspected; only servers/browser processes started by this worktree stopped — none left orphaned
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow phase-03-e2e-evidence-and-closeout.md exactly — it contains the full test designs and the ordered validation steps. Reuse e2e/fixtures/workflows/e2e-queue-guidance.yaml (30s first-turn delay) and the fake provider's opt-in echoPrompt directive — every absence assertion MUST use an echo-enabled unique marker; a plain prompt is not evidence. Attach response promises before each action. If the 30s window is empirically insufficient, add a separate longer-delay fixture — do not modify Story 2.1's fixture or hide with sleeps. No new Playwright dependency, fixture change to the existing file, or runtime helper. Do not claim axe or screen-reader passes. Parked/actor/500/race coverage stays in US-001 unit tests — do not repeat through Playwright.
